correctness.rationale: Over any characteristic-three field, the 48-by-48 fixed-scalar Hom-Jacobi minor for \(\mathfrak{psl}_3\) has determinant 1 in \(\mathbb F_3\), so its 48 non-scalar coefficients vanish. The bracket constants are reconstructed from elementary 3x3 matrices in verify.py, and an independent basis/elimination in crosscheck.py gives the same nullity. \(\mathfrak{sl}_3\) is perfect with center \(kI_3\); its Hom-Lie maps descend, and scalar maps plus all eight-dimensional central-valued maps provide the complete lift. Explicit block multiplication establishes the associative algebra and finite-field unit/idempotent counts.
